scenes.heading: Refresh your top content every three months

sents.d: Refresh your top content every three months
Your best posts lose trust and traffic when they go out of date. A quarterly refresh fixes that.
Old prices or discontinued products make readers doubt everything else you say.
Search engines tend to push stale pages down too.
Every three months, check your top five posts.
Fix broken links, swap outdated products, refresh screenshots, and add an updated note at the top.

take: Keep your best content current, and it keeps earning trust and traffic.
